speaker: thomas_pope
text: He is on again. The rope is still here, which is how you know the tale has left with him. I am not repeating it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not repeat it. I have the bench, and I have the rule about the door, and I am already tired of both. I will keep them.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am off for a longer piece now. I will not stand in the crack of the door. The cloth can do the listening.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it. If thou art cold, be cold in here. I have nothing to lend thee but a pot of water, and the water is for paint, not for courage.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The end is not yet. John has not come to the inner door. When he does, it will be to count us, not to hear a report.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then he will find us counted. I am not composing a report for a man who has not asked.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Good. My mouth is empty. I would like it to stay empty until they want it full.
